proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect.grant_inspiration_die
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing ClassFeatureEffect union only covers grant_extra_action and heal_hp. Bardic Inspiration grants a Bardic Inspiration die (a reusable die resource) to another creature. The recipient holds it and may spend it post-roll after failing a D20 Test to add the die's value to the d20, potentially turning failure into success. No current variant can represent this without misrepresenting the rule.
proposed_widenings.evidence: That creature gains one of your Bardic Inspiration dice. Once within the next hour when the creature fails a D20 Test, the creature can roll the Bardic Inspiration die and add the number rolled to the d20, potentially turning the failure into a success. A Bardic Inspiration die is expended when it's rolled.

proposed_widenings.name: UseCountCap.ability_modifier
proposed_widenings.justification: The current UseCountCap has fixed (literal number) and threshold_tiers (level-tiered number) variants. Bardic Inspiration's use count is the caster's Charisma modifier (minimum 1) — an ability-score-derived cap with no level axis. A new variant is required to represent this without hardcoding an incorrect fixed number.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can confer a Bardic Inspiration die a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

notes: The outer shell fits cleanly: class_feature kind, activation family, bonus_action activation cost, long_rest reset cadence. The two blockers are (1) no ClassFeatureEffect variant for granting a post-roll modifier die to a target creature and (2) no UseCountCap variant for ability-modifier-based caps. The die-size scaling (d6 at L1, d8 at L5, d10 at L10, d12 at L15) is expressible via DiceAmount.threshold_tiers with axis=class once blocker (1) is resolved — scale_die_size is already a v4 atom. All v4 atoms needed (post_roll_window, modify_roll_numeric, scale_die_size, use_count, bonus_action_quota, rest_window) already exist in the taxonomy. No trace produced — atoms_used and relations_used are empty.
